newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia TCV 2008 bond tender yields 7.860.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia TCV 2008 bond tender yields 7.860.

text.p: The Treasury Corp of Victoria (TCV) said its tender of its 7.5 percent August 2008 stock produced an weighted average yield (WAY) of 7.860 percent.
OFFERED A$200 MLN COUPON 7.5 PCT MATURITY 15.08.08
TCV is the central borrowing authority for the state of Victoria.

TCV said the 2008, a stock being issued for the first time, went at a margin of 18.5 points over the Commonwealth government August 2008 bond. The issue yield was also 10 basis points above TCV's November 2006 bond and 22 points over futures, TCV said.
To boost liquidity in the new line, TCV is allowing switching from other TCV issues into the new 2008 line. This process would start at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT).
The final amount of the consolidation would depend on market demand, TCV said.
